title: 第7章 铁线臂密信第8章血肉灵胚
slug: 矿奴开局八极拳打穿三十六重天
content_zh:
十二支淬毒灵弩，箭簇绿光映在苏意瞳孔里。
方仲站在十二人身后，声音很平静：“我赶时间。
死的也行。”
他抬手的动作很慢。
落下时很快。
“放！”
弓弦声叠成一声。
十二支弩箭离弦，绿光在空中拉出十二条弧线，封死了所有退路。
左右全是树，身后是庙门，头顶是压下来的箭雨。
退无可退。
苏意做了唯一能做的事。
他抬起双臂，交叉护在面门。
这个动作不是思考的结果——是身体自己做的。
前世在工地扎钢筋，钢筋笼子突然塌了，几十根钢筋砸下来，他也是这么抬手的。
铁丝勒进手套里的血印子还没结痂，手臂不能抖，一抖钢筋就扎歪，扎歪了整面墙的钢筋都得重来。
那口气提在胸口，双臂纹丝不动。
现在也一样。
弩箭到了。
第一支射中左前臂。
叮。

金属碰撞声。
箭簇在青灰色的皮肤上擦出一星火花，弹飞了。
第二支，第三支，第四支——叮叮叮叮叮叮叮。
声音密集得像雨打铁皮棚。
十二支弩箭全部弹飞，歪歪扭扭插在地上，箭簇的绿光还在亮，映着方仲那张渐渐凝固的脸。
苏意的袖子被射烂了。
破布条下面露出两条手臂——青灰色，光泽如铁，皮肤表面能看到凸起的筋络，像铁丝编成的网裹在肌肉外面。
弩箭只在上面留了十二个白点，正在以肉眼可见的速度消退。
洪家铁线拳·铁线臂。
前世工地扎钢筋练出来的功夫。
铁丝勒进手套，血印子叠血印子，但手臂不能抖——一抖就扎歪。
日复一日，年复一年，手臂上的皮肉被铁丝一寸一寸勒硬了。
硬到后来，铁丝勒上去只有白印子，不流血。
加上淬火锻身诀三天三夜的崩裂修复。
那十二个白点现在也消了。
方仲的瞳孔收缩了一下。
他看清楚了——不是护甲，不是灵器，是纯粹的肉身强度。
一个矿奴，没有灵力波动，把手臂练到能弹开淬毒弩箭的地步。
content_en:
Twelve poison-quenching spirit crossbows, the green light of the arrow clusters reflected in Su Yi's pupils.
Fang Zhong stood behind the twelve people, his voice was very calm: "I'm in a hurry.
Even dead ones. "
He raised his hand very slowly.
It falls quickly.
"Let go!"
The sound of bowstrings overlapped into one sound.
Twelve crossbow arrows left the string, and the green light drew twelve arcs in the air, sealing all escape routes.
There are trees to the left and right, the temple gate is behind you, and the rain of arrows is pressing down on your head.
There is no way to retreat.
Su Yi did the only thing he could do.
He raised his arms and crossed them in front of his face.
This action is not the result of thinking—the body does it on its own.
In his previous life, he was laying steel bars at a construction site. The steel cage suddenly collapsed and dozens of steel bars fell down. He raised his hands in the same way.
The blood marks from the wire stuck in the gloves have not yet scabbed over, and I cannot shake my arms. The steel bars are bent when I shake them, and the steel bars on the entire wall have to be re-wired.
The breath was raised in his chest, his arms motionless.
Same now.
The crossbow arrows have arrived.
The first shot hit the left forearm.
bite.
The sound of metal clashing.
The arrow cluster struck a spark on the blue-grey skin and bounced away.
Second branch, third branch, fourth branch - ding ding ding ding ding ding.
The sound was as dense as rain hitting a tin shed.
All twelve crossbow arrows bounced away and stuck crookedly on the ground. The green light of the arrow clusters was still bright, reflecting Fang Zhong's gradually solidifying face.
Su Yi's sleeve was shot to pieces.
Two arms were exposed under the rag strips - blue-grey, as shiny as iron, with raised tendons visible on the surface of the skin, like a network of wires wrapped around the muscles.
The crossbow arrows only left twelve white spots on them, which were fading away at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Hong Family Iron Fist·Iron Arm.
Kung fu gained from tying steel bars at a construction site in his previous life.
The wire was cut into the glove, leaving blood marks on top of blood marks, but you couldn't shake your arm - if you shook it, it would get stuck.
Day after day, year after year, the flesh on my arms was tightened inch by inch by the wire.
It was so hard that when the wire was tightened, there was only a white mark without bleeding.
In addition, it took three days and three nights to repair the cracks using the Tempering Body Forging Technique.
The twelve white spots are now gone.
Fang Zhong's pupils shrank.
He saw it clearly - it was not armor, not a spiritual weapon, it was pure physical strength.
A mining slave with no spiritual power fluctuations has trained his arms to the point where he can deflect poison-quenched crossbow arrows.
